newsitem.title: FRANCE: Best French barley bid worth $150 per tonne.
newsitem.headline: Best French barley bid worth $150 per tonne.

text.p: The best bid for barley export subsidies through France on Thursday valued the grain at around $150 per tonne for May shipment, grain traders.
The bid for a refund of 14.49 Ecus per tonne was placed at the European Union's weekly export tender.
In total traders sought subsidies for 153,700 tonnes of barley in a range of 14.49 to 19.94 Ecus per tonne, cereals office ONIC said.
Traders had no immediate word on the breakdown of bids.
There were no rye export bids.
The wheat export tender is closed.
